description: Add a local file, or every supported file of a local folder (recursively by default), from the user's computer to a Matrix context as ONE background job: extract text, chunk, embed if the context has an embedding model. Only paths inside the folders Matrix may read are allowed: the folder Claude Code was started in, folders from the plugin settings and folders the user allowed (list_allowed_folders). For any other path the user is asked and decides - tell them in words first which folder and why; never try to get around a refusal. A symlink or `..` counts by where it leads; symlinked folders inside a folder are not followed; hidden files and folders are skipped. Formats: pdf (scans are read by text recognition), Office, OpenDocument, mail, html, text/markdown, csv, images, zip, ...; max 64 MB per file, up to 500 files per call. Use an absolute path. Returns {job_id, files_queued, files, skipped}; poll job_status (result: docs_created, chunks_staged, chunks_from_scanned_pages, attachments_from_mail_text (attachments found only as text inside a mail, e.g. in a returned mail: tell the user), embedded, skipped per file, files_total, files_read, chunking). Files already in the context are skipped; from then on Matrix keeps the context up to date with this file or folder by itself (new and changed files are read again before searches, deleted ones are marked missing).

path.description: Absolute path of a file or folder inside a shared folder.

recursive.description: For a folder: include subfolders (default true).

name: add_files
